trends.name: Iran-US Military Escalation
trends.summary: First US fighter jet (F-15E) shot down over Iran since Iraq war; pilot missing. Trump threatens Iranian infrastructure destruction but signals negotiations remain open. Market is pricing in potential sustained Middle East conflict and oil supply disruption.

trends.name: Credit Default Swap Surge & Default Hedging
trends.summary: CDS trading volume surged 69% in Q1 2026 to $4.5 trillion—highest on record, exceeding Q2 2025 tariff turmoil peak. Investors aggressively hedging corporate defaults signals recession fears and credit stress despite equity market recovery.

trends.name: Energy Sector Outperformance
trends.summary: Wall Street rotating into lagging oil-and-gas stocks in anticipation of longer-term Iran conflict disruption. Geopolitical premium supporting energy assets as strait of Hormuz supply risks re-emerge.

trends.name: Retirement Account Stress & Hardship Withdrawals
trends.summary: Record 6% of retirement plan holders requested hardship withdrawals in 2025 (up from 4.8% in 2024, ~2% pre-pandemic). Signal of financial stress among savers and potential consumption headwinds ahead.

trends.name: Federal Debt Interest Payments Exploding
trends.summary: US net interest payments on federal debt projected to exceed $1 trillion in 2026 (up from $970B in 2025, $882B in 2024). Structural fiscal headwind limiting policy flexibility and crowding out productive spending.

trends.name: Jobs Growth Softer Than Expected
trends.summary: US added 178,000 jobs in March (better than expected but modest trend). Unemployment steady at 4.3%. Gains concentrated in healthcare, construction, transportation—signals uneven labor market and potential demand slowdown.

trends.name: OpenAI Leadership Turmoil & M&A Strategy
trends.summary: OpenAI COO Fidji Simo takes medical leave amid leadership changes. Recent TBPN acquisition (online talk show platform) signals chaotic M&A strategy, raising investor concerns about capital allocation and strategic focus.

trends.name: Meta/Google Section 230 Legal Shield Under Attack
trends.summary: Court cases bypass 30-year-old Section 230 legal protections for Meta and Google. Potential liability expansion could force major operational/content moderation changes and increase compliance costs for big tech.

trends.name: Gilead-Galapagos M&A & Pharma Consolidation
trends.summary: Gilead Sciences pursuing M&A with Galapagos NV. Part of broader pharma consolidation trend as companies seek pipeline diversification and strategic scale amid healthcare reforms and pricing pressure.

trends.name: Mortgage Market Repricing After Sell-Off
trends.summary: MBS (mortgage-backed securities) becoming attractive after recent sell-off. Housing market showing buyer leverage returning; mortgage rates stabilizing creates refinancing opportunities and renewed affordability.

trends.name: AI & Satellite Infrastructure Secular Growth
trends.summary: Chip stocks gaining as SpaceX and Amazon push major satellite expansion projects. Emerging secular growth story in semiconductor demand from space infrastructure and AI computing buildout.

trends.name: Treasury Yields Rising on Stronger Labor Data
trends.summary: Treasury yields climbed modestly after March jobs beat expectations (178K vs. expected ~150K). Rate market recalibrating Fed pause expectations; inflation concerns resurface from tight labor market.
